text.tspan: Who reads, who decides, who corrects
Care and a private record answer practical needs left open by the political sheet.
The need for reading and an account
She reads both labels again without
One requires open doors; the other says
Calls the hour a rehearsal; a margin asks
One writes the other's account; the speaker
C > B: conflicting instructions / B > A: reading without deciding / D > A: proposes an interpretation / E > A: makes a corrected copy
The private copy is corrected by its speaker; it is not guaranteed to preserve every resident's account.
